labels.caption: I.i.d.\ stress-intensity curves on weeks 101 (1 week, policy seed 0): the cost over all-fallback of 14 policies, Sublet, critical-ratio renting, protected-only renting, the primary baselines and the notice-aware policies, against the reclaim probability $p$ of the i.i.d.\ lender per site and slot, $p\in\{0, 0.0005, 0.002, 0.0124, 0.05, 0.2\}$; $p=0$ is the honoring lender L-hon, drawn left of the break, and $p=0.0005$ and $p=0.002$ convert SpotLake's interruption fractions to a constant hazard per site-slot (a derived conversion). Medians over the weeks, bars min--max. Sublet is drawn in every panel, and each curve is named at its right end; the grey line marks all-fallback; the series of a panel are offset horizontally by 1.4~pt. Protected-only renting holds no revocable lease, so its cost is the same at every $p$. Every policy under every lender, critical-ratio planning, its ablation with the $k^{\ast}$ contract and the regional and peak-aligned lenders included: Table~\ref{tab:e7r-modes}; the first crossing of all-fallback and the lender of $W_0^{+}$: Table~\ref{tab:e7r-stress}.
